committee: * Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 480-38 (COR) - Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Certificate No. 480-38 (COR) to the four guest speakers of the 27 th Annual Guam Diabetes Conference, relative to recognizing their participation and commending them for their commitment to advancing diabetes education and community health in Guam. The presentation is scheduled for Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. at the Hilton Guam Resort & Spa. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary, Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane, at 671-989-2572 or via email at office.senatorbri@ guamlegislature.gov .
